vocabulary.meaning_en: rules and actions that keep people safe at work
vocabulary.example: Our company has a clear health and safety policy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an official set of rules in a company
vocabulary.example: Smoking in the office is against company policy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the official way of doing something, step by step
vocabulary.example: Please learn the fire procedure in your first week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a practice of what to do if there is a fire
vocabulary.example: We have a fire drill every three months.

vocabulary.meaning_en: warn people that there is danger
vocabulary.example: If you see smoke, raise the alarm at once.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a loud bell or sound that warns of a fire
vocabulary.example: The fire alarm went off at ten o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an alarm when there is no real danger
vocabulary.example: Don't worry, it was only a false alarm.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a door you use to leave a building in a fire
vocabulary.example: The nearest fire exit is at the end of the corridor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a quiet way, without panic
vocabulary.example: Please walk calmly to the door.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place outside where everyone meets after leaving a building
vocabulary.example: Our assembly point is in the car park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the buildings and land that a company uses
vocabulary.example: No smoking on company premises.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large building where goods are stored
vocabulary.example: The boxes are kept in the warehouse.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an event, usually something bad or unusual
vocabulary.example: Please report every incident to your manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an official list of names
vocabulary.example: The manager took a register of everyone outside.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a board or picture that gives information
vocabulary.example: Follow the green signs to the exit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: needing attention immediately
vocabulary.example: I have an urgent message for the manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a duty to take care of something
vocabulary.example: Your safety is our responsibility.

vocabulary.meaning_en: able to hurt people
vocabulary.example: Smoking near boxes is highly dangerous.

vocabulary.meaning_en: come together in one place
vocabulary.example: Could you all gather in the meeting room, please?

vocabulary.word: let the cat out of the bag
vocabulary.meaning_en: tell a secret by mistake
vocabulary.example: He let the cat out of the bag about the new project.

fine_lines.title: alarm vs drill
fine_lines.explanation_ar: alarm هو صوت الإنذار نفسه، أما drill فهو تمرين أو تدريب على الإخلاء دون خطر حقيقي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: An alarm is the warning sound. A drill is a practice, with no real danger.

examples.sentence: Today's fire drill took ten minutes.

fine_lines.title: calm vs calmly
fine_lines.explanation_ar: calm صفة تصف الشخص (be calm)، وcalmly ظرف يصف طريقة الفعل (walk calmly).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Calm is an adjective (stay calm). Calmly is an adverb (walk calmly).

examples.sentence: She spoke calmly to the team.

expressions.phrase: If you see a fire, raise the alarm.
expressions.meaning_en: If there is a fire, warn everyone.
expressions.example: If you see a fire, raise the alarm and call the fire service.

expressions.phrase: Walk calmly to your nearest fire exit.
expressions.meaning_ar: امشِ بهدوء إلى أقرب مخرج طوارئ.
expressions.meaning_en: Go to the closest exit without running.
expressions.example: When the alarm rings, walk calmly to your nearest fire exit.

expressions.phrase: Meet at the fire assembly point.
expressions.meaning_en: Go to the meeting place outside.
expressions.example: After you leave, meet at the fire assembly point.

expressions.meaning_en: You cannot smoke anywhere in the company's buildings.
expressions.example: Please remember: no smoking on company premises.

expressions.phrase: Could you gather everyone in the meeting room, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك جمع الجميع في غرفة الاجتماعات من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite request to bring people together.
expressions.example: Could you gather everyone in the meeting room, please? I have news.
Your safety is our responsibility, so please follow the rules.

expressions.phrase: Is everyone clear about what to do?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل الجميع يعرف بوضوح ما يجب فعله؟
expressions.example: Is everyone clear about what to do if the alarm rings?

grammar.title: Imperatives for safety instructions
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم صيغة الأمر (الفعل في أوله بدون فاعل) لإعطاء تعليمات سلامة واضحة وقصيرة: Walk, Meet, Raise. وللنفي نستخدم Don't أو No + اسم بصيغة -ing على اللافتات: No smoking.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the imperative (base verb, no subject) for clear safety rules: Walk calmly. Meet outside. For negative rules use Don't..., or No + -ing on signs: No smoking.

grammar.title: First conditional for rules: If + present, imperative
grammar.explanation_ar: نصف ما يجب فعله في موقف معيّن: If + مضارع بسيط، ثم فعل أمر. If you see a fire, raise the alarm.
grammar.explanation_en: To say what to do in a situation: If + present simple, then an imperative.
examples: If you see a fire, raise the alarm.
If you hear the alarm, leave the building.
If you smell smoke, call the fire service.

questions.question: What does "raise the alarm" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: raise the alarm تعني تنبيه الناس إلى وجود خطر.
questions.explanation_en: It means warning people that there is danger.

questions.question: Walk ___ to your nearest fire exit.
questions.explanation_ar: نحتاج ظرفًا يصف الفعل walk، فنقول calmly.
questions.explanation_en: We need an adverb after the verb walk: calmly.

questions.question: Where do you meet after leaving the building?
questions.explanation_ar: نقطة التجمع assembly point هي مكان اللقاء خارج المبنى.
questions.explanation_en: The assembly point is the meeting place outside.

questions.question: "No smoking on company ___."
questions.explanation_ar: كلمة premises بمعنى مباني الشركة تأتي دائمًا بصيغة الجمع.
questions.explanation_en: Premises (always plural) means the company's buildings.

questions.question: A fire drill is...
questions.explanation_ar: fire drill هو تمرين على الإخلاء.
questions.explanation_en: A fire drill is a practice.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: If you will see a fire, raise the alarm.
If you see a fire, raise the alarm.
If you saw a fire, raises the alarm.
If see you a fire, raise the alarm.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد if نستخدم المضارع البسيط ثم فعل الأمر.
questions.explanation_en: After if use the present simple, then the imperative.

questions.question: Tom said the alarm is usually a ___ alarm (no real fire).
questions.explanation_ar: false alarm إنذار بدون خطر حقيقي.
questions.explanation_en: A false alarm has no real danger.

questions.question: "Let the cat out of the bag" means...
questions.explanation_ar: هذا التعبير يعني إفشاء سرّ دون قصد.
questions.explanation_en: This idiom means telling a secret by mistake.

questions.question: A large building where goods are kept is a...
Which is a safety instruction (imperative)?
questions.explanation_ar: صيغة الأمر تبدأ بالفعل مباشرة: Use the stairs.
questions.explanation_en: An imperative starts with the base verb: Use the stairs.
